comment: Scripted interaction for `openhost --app pocketcasts` — the REAL pocket-casts options-picker sheet (Sources/RealAppProbe, docs/REAL_APP_TEST.md). Window 393x852; the sheet rests at y 509 and is 343 pt tall. Rows in window coordinates: title 509-549, Play 549-621, Download 622-694, Up Next Swipe 695-767 (its UISwitch centred at 343,731), Remove Download 768-840. Sequence: the sheet's own present animation (the app calls present(animated: true)); a tap on the switch, which runs the app's Selector.named("switchToggled:") action and leaves the sheet up; then a press-and-hold on the Play row (SimpleActionView.touchesBegan animates its background to primaryUi01Active) whose release fires the app's actionTapped, which calls animateOut and dismisses the sheet — all of it the app's own code.
